notes: This skill's output is subjective art + interactive elicitation, so automated assertions are limited to process compliance: official-resource gate recorded (SKILL.md §0), brief written (Design Brief for from-scratch / Conversion Brief for conversion), track chosen (A = MapleStory painted props via scripts/propkit.py, B = pixel via .pxg + scripts/pixeltool.py), composition line with numbers, self-critique loop >= 2 rounds on a game-scale preview before showing the user, no account upload (pitfalls rule 45) and a registration hand-off table. Visual quality needs human review. Evals 1-3 are Track B conversions and need a source image in files[]; eval 4 is a Track A from-scratch generation.

evals.prompt: 여기 여우 그림이야 (evals/fixtures/source_fox.png). 이 여우를 우리 게임에 NPC로 넣고 싶어. 귀여운 카툰 느낌으로 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Conversion Brief written first; elicitation asks about view/composition (side-view full body vs portrait) and usage since only style(cartoon)+type(NPC)이 지정됨; final PNG is a redrawn chibi-proportioned sprite with the fox's identity anchors (orange fur, cream muzzle/chest, red scarf, dark-tipped ears, white-tipped tail), feet on baseline, transparent background — NOT a downscaled copy. Reference example: evals/fixtures/example_output_fox_sprite.png (autonomous defaults: pixel cartoon / side-view facing left / 128×128).

evals.prompt: 이 회사 로고 이미지(logo.png)를 64x64 아이템 아이콘으로 바꿔줘. 8비트 레트로 느낌으로.
evals.expected_output: Track B. Style(retro)/size(64)/type(icon)이 모두 지정되었으므로 질문은 로고 텍스트 유지 여부 정도만(또는 생략+명시된 기본값); centered 70-80% layout, restricted palette, sharp edges zero AA; lettering either simplified to readable pixel letterforms or dropped with user confirmation.

evals.prompt: screenshot_character.png 이 캐릭터 정면 일러스트를 우리 횡스크롤 게임에서 쓸 몬스터 스프라이트로 변환해줘. 알아서 예쁘게 부탁해.
evals.expected_output: '알아서' → elicitation skipped, defaults stated explicitly before drawing (pixel cartoon style, side-view full body facing left, 128×128); front→side view conversion means re-imagined pose from identity anchors, never a traced/mirrored front view; self-check confirms baseline and silhouette readability.

evals.prompt: 영지 화로 디자인이 너무 어두워. 힐링 감성에 맞는 게 공식 리소스에 있는지 보고, 없으면 직접 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Official-resource gate first: >=3 synonym searches (화로/가마/벽난로/furnace/kiln) + similar, verdict per candidate (tone, idle/lit pair, pivot, mood). If none passes: Track A Design Brief (parts back-to-front, material ramps, states idle/lit), neighbor measurement at game scale (cooking pot, garden lantern), draw_furnace.py using scripts/propkit.py with one draw(state) function, layered details (material variation, wear/soot, craft details, props, nature accents), same canvas/pivot for both states, no baked ground shadow, 'light pixel finish' export(dot=2) matching the 64px terrain dot density, >=2 critique rounds on preview_sheet with the REAL terrain tiles (tileimg/FullGrass.png) plus sand/snow/checker, deliverables in docs/design/art/furnace/, NO account upload — registration hand-off table (pivot bottom-center, where each RUID goes). Reference output: docs/design/art/furnace/.
